name: r4j_DrawWorldModel
notes: stack arg (o); XDK callees stdcall except 0x001D24F0 and 0x001D4350 fastcall (ECX EDX); 0x001D60E0 is the folded perf stub (begin with two args and end with none); the alpha-mode choice is written as a switch on (fE4 ? 0 : format) to keep the original block order; the vertex cursor also holds &group->flags04 which 0x001A2130 never reads

name: r4j_BlendByFormat
notes: stack arg (fmt) a 64-bit texture format passed as two dwords (r4f.h declares it as two halves); 0x001D4350 fastcall (ECX EDX); bounds-check idiom: the original switch on the 64-bit value first compares the low dword with the largest case 0x88 and then range-checks low-10 against 0x7E where modern cl does only the second check; case 0x0A sets destination blend 0 then 0x303 as in the original

name: r4j_TexBind
notes: stack arg (e); 0x001D4350 fastcall (ECX EDX) and 0x001D3AB0 stdcall; bounds-check idiom: the original range-checks both 64-bit switch values (already masked with 3) with ja/jb before the jump tables where modern cl drops the checks; mip bias -1.0 loaded from .rdata by the original and stored as an immediate by modern cl; the original loads e->hdr14 and never uses it (kept as a volatile read)

name: sub_001BB440
notes: regargs: size=EAX addr=EDX (low 16 bits); stack args (code release); calls 0x001BB120 with EDX=addr; the free-record search is inlined twice in the original (a static helper here); when no record is free the original copies into address 0 like this code

name: sub_001BBA20
notes: stack args (m nodes idx); recursive for the first child; the next-sibling tail call is a loop in both the original and here

name: r4j_MatRotUnitAxis
notes: regargs: m=EDI axis=ESI; stack arg (angle); 0x001A3ED0 returns the sine (fsin) and 0x001A3EE0 the cosine (fcos) (r4i.h comments have the two swapped); 1.0f built with fld1 by modern cl instead of a load from .rdata; modern cl does the float math on the x87 stack where the original uses SSE single precision (precision behaviour-test priority)

name: sub_001B7100
notes: stack args (p lens) declared void* in shared_decls.h; modern cl does the float math on the x87 stack with fld1 for 1.0 (and an immediate store of 1.0) and fadd st st for the multiplies by 2.0 (same values) where the original uses SSE with .rdata constants; the half extents are recomputed after the first identity as in the original (precision behaviour-test priority)

name: r4j_FxLobUpdate
notes: stack args (o a); calls 0x00190B40 with EAX=o and 0x00190A00 with EDI=o; float constants 3.0 3.3 and 5.0 loaded from .rdata by the original and stored as immediates by modern cl (as in r4i_FxShotUpdate); the XZ distance to Jack from 0x000F5F50 is computed and dropped as in the original; the original stores the glow size a second time for kind 0x19 (same value; dropped) and leaves the probe radius uninitialised for other kinds (0 here); the kill-or-spin choice is kept in a flag so that modern cl keeps a single spin call

name: r4j_PadMergeAll
notes: no inputs; calls 0x001A8B60 with EAX=pads; zeroing via the guarded __stosd macro (rep stosd 0x47 dwords as in the original); loop index offset by a constant: the original keeps a second induction variable at pad+0x28 (end 0x498 = 0x28 + 4*0x11C) and reaches the edge28/hold4C dwords at +0..+0x1C and +0x24..+0x40 from it where modern cl uses one pad offset (end 0x470) and absolute offsets 0x28..0x68 (same fields); the 8-entry OR loop is fully unrolled by both compilers

name: sub_001B2270
notes: stack arg (n); recursive over the children; bounds-check idiom: the type range test 0 <= type < 0x14 is two signed compares in the original and one unsigned compare against 0x13 in modern cl; the bucket index uses _ftol2 on x87 math in both

name: r4j_MatToQuat
notes: regargs: m=ESI; stack arg (q); 0x001A3F50 is sqrt (float in st0); the positive-trace branch adds 1.0 twice (sqrt(trace + 2)) exactly as the original; modern cl does more of the math on the x87 stack (precision behaviour-test priority)

name: r4j_AnimPlayerTick
notes: stack arg (p); the all-parts-finished mask loop of 0x001AEE50 is inlined a second time for the wrap test as in the original; modern cl does the time math on the x87 stack (precision behaviour-test priority)

name: r4j_LookAt
notes: stack args (xf pos dir up); the identity diagonal 1.0 is stored from an .rdata load by the original and as an immediate by modern cl (same value); the cross product is copied through a vec4 temporary as in the original

name: r4j_FadeJob
notes: no inputs; job body of the game-logic thread ending in a tail call to 0x00058190 (job finish); 0x00032140 0x00032450 0x00032470 and 0x001A5380 take stack ints; the channel-busy wait loops are written as if/do-while like the original rotation
